info.title: Dataset Service API
info.description: Dataset archives, imports and images. Public datasets allow anonymous reads. User API keys use dataset scopes; pipeline keys read public datasets and datasets belonging to their project owner.

tags.name: Datasets
tags.description: Dataset ownership, archives and imported items

DatasetLicense.description: What the publisher declares the data is licensed under. Visin shows it and does not interpret it; a dataset without one has not said, which is not permission to use it. Absent means unstated.

id.description: A listed licence id (the Hugging Face Hub's spelling), or `other`.

url.description: The licence text. Always set for a listed licence; optional for `other`.

commercial.description: false when the licence forbids commercial use. Absent for `other`.

name.description: A group's name, when you are in it; a person's name, as they agreed to show it.

handle.description: A person's handle, the address of their public page. Absent when they hid their profile.

picture.description: A person's avatar, when they have one and agreed to show it.

credit.description: The credit line or citation the licence or the data's authors ask for, as the publisher wrote it.

source.description: Set when the dataset lives on the Hugging Face Hub. Visin keeps only this pointer; the zip below, if any, is the local copy. Absent means the zip kept here is the dataset.

revision.description: The full commit hash, never a branch or tag.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: A person's id; only the datasets that person owns, of those you may read. What a public profile lists.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: `public` keeps only the datasets anyone can open, so your own private ones do not mix in. What Explore lists.

get.description:
The licences a dataset can declare, in the order a form offers them, ending with `other`. Declare one by
`{ "id": "cc-by-4.0" }`, or `{ "id": "other", "name": "…", "url": "…" }` for a licence that is not listed.

get.summary: What a person or a group has made in public
get.description:
The public datasets a person created, or a group owns, newest first. Derived on each request from the datasets
themselves, so a dataset made private, trashed or deleted leaves it at once. Only public datasets count, whoever
asks, so it reads the same to its owner as to a stranger.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: A person's account id. Give this or `owner`, not both.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: A group's id: the public datasets that group owns. Give this or `user`, not both.

data.description:
How to fetch the dataset. With a Hub `source`, download it from the Hub at `source.revision`
and use the zip (`downloadUrl`) only as the fallback. A dataset on the Hub alone has no
`downloadUrl`, `filename`, `size` or `expiresAt`.

revision.description: What a client that follows `source` records as the version it used - the Hub commit - or, without a source, the archive's upload time.

archiveRevision.description: Version of the archive addressed by `downloadUrl`. Record this one when falling back to the zip.

get.summary: What the Hub says about a dataset's repo
get.description:
For a dataset with a Hugging Face `source`: the repo's card fields, size, top-level folders (where the splits
usually are) and first files, read from the Hub's API at the pinned commit. Nothing is copied. Only public
repos can be read: a private or missing one answers `404`. Answers are kept for an hour. A dataset with no
`source` answers `400`.

200.description: The repo as the Hub describes it

truncated.description: More files than the first hundred listed.

400.description: The dataset is not kept on the Hub

403.description: The caller may not read the dataset

404.description: The repo or commit is missing or private
